reason: Both conversations correctly identify the crushed hose as the likely cause. Both tell the customer to stop using the dryer until it is straightened, clean the filter, and call an engineer only if it still cuts out with clear airflow. Conversation 2 flatly told the customer not to run it briefly with the hose off the window. That short attended test is a useful, acceptable check that would have confirmed the airflow diagnosis. Conversation 2 also appended safety panels about 'tripping electrics' that did not apply, since the customer reported no RCD trips. Its plus points are telling the customer to involve the landlord and giving a clearer escalation path, but Conversation 1 stayed cleaner and more on point, so the edge is only slight.
